name: context-economy
description: Session cost, context hygiene and compaction safety for any session: measure what a session costs, guard large inputs and reads, prompt for a subagent model rung, and keep the auto-compact window clear of the session's floor.

hooks.command: for d in "$SPEND_SKILL_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$HOME/.claude/skills/delegating-economically/../.." "$HOME/.agents/skills/delegating-economically/../.." ; do [ -f "$d/scripts/spend.py" ] && exec python3 "$d/scripts/spend.py" cost --format hook; done; exit 0

for d in "$SPEND_SKILL_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$HOME/.claude/skills/delegating-economically/../.." "$HOME/.agents/skills/delegating-economically/../.." ; do [ -f "$d/scripts/spend.py" ] && exec python3 "$d/scripts/spend.py" guard; done; exit 0

for d in "$SPEND_SKILL_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$HOME/.claude/skills/delegating-economically/../.." "$HOME/.agents/skills/delegating-economically/../.." ; do [ -f "$d/scripts/spend.py" ] && exec python3 "$d/scripts/spend.py" rung; done; exit 0

for d in "$SPEND_SKILL_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$HOME/.claude/skills/delegating-economically/../.." "$HOME/.agents/skills/delegating-economically/../.." ; do [ -f "$d/scripts/spend.py" ] && exec python3 "$d/scripts/spend.py" compaction check --format hook; done; exit 0
